pitch:
The Aldera 30-Day Magnesium Pass. Checked before you buy: every batch is tested by an independent lab, the lab is named, and the report for your batch is on the product page and behind the QR code on the box. The batch number on the box matches the report.
What's inside: one foil sachet a day, 2 vegetable capsules of magnesium bisglycinate, 200 mg elemental magnesium, no magnesium oxide. One known dose, written on the box and checked by the lab. Your 2 capsules are already counted; take them in the evening, at home or wherever you are tonight.
$29.99 for 30 days. Launch price $24.99 for the first box until January 15, 2027. Two boxes $49.99, that is $0.83 a day.
Empty-box guarantee: take all 30 sachets; if you are not happy, write to us and get your money back. Nothing to send back.
In the box: a 30-day tracker card and a simple card on how and when to take it.
Made in China. Every batch is tested in the U.S. by an independent named lab before it is sold.
Sold on TikTok Shop, ships from the US. First batch is limited to 1,000 boxes.
